name: AESplat
definition: A pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that decouples appearance modeling into view-independent (zeroth-order SH) and view-dependent (higher-order SH) components to improve rendering quality over unified prediction paradigms.
summary: AESplat is a pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that improves novel view synthesis by decoupling appearance modeling into view-independent and view-dependent components.
